reason: Fixed exceptional loop issue by creating an ultra-minimal interrupt handler that avoids ALL callbacks. The previous implementation was calling TxCpltCallback and RxCpltCallback which could potentially call HAL_UART_Transmit_IT or other functions that would trigger recursive calls to HAL_UART_IRQHandler. The new implementation only updates the state machine (marks transmission/reception as complete) and clears error codes, without calling any callbacks. This completely eliminates the possibility of recursive loops while still allowing the state machine to progress.
